title.en: I pay homage to my King

fragments.text: אַנְסִיכָה מַלְכִּי. לְפָנָיו בְּהִתְהַלְּכִי. אָמְצוֹ בְּהַמְלִיכִי. יֶאֱזוֹר עֹז וְיִמְלוֹךְ:
אֱלִיל בְּהַשְׁלִיכִי. לִפְנֵי בּוֹא יוֹם מַלְכִּי. אִישׁ מַלְאָכִי יִשְׁלַח, וְאָז יִמְלֹךְ:
בְּבוֹאוֹ לַהֲלוֹךְ. נְתוֹשׁ חָנֵף מִמְּלוֹךְ. בֵּית גֵּאִים בְּלִי מְלוֹךְ. יִסַּח לְבַל יִמְלֹךְ:
בְּתוֹכִי יַהֲלוֹךְ. בְּהוֹפִיעוֹ לִמְלוֹךְ. בְּמַלְכוּתוֹ אֶמְלוֹךְ. וְאָז יִמְלֹךְ:
גְּבֶרֶת מַמְלָכוֹת. בְּמַגְּרוֹ מַמְלָכוֹת. גּוֹיִם וּמַמְלָכוֹת. יָהוֹם וְהוּא יִמְלֹךְ:
גִּלְיוֹן הֲלִיכוֹת. וְסֵפֶר תַּהֲלוּכוֹת. גַּל הַיּוֹם לְזַכּוֹת. חוֹכָיו לִמְלוֹךְ:
דּוֹרֶכֶת נְסִיכוּת. בְּחִנּוּן קוֹל בָּכוּת. דִּבְּרָה אֲנִי בְּמַלְכוּת. וּמִי יוּכַל לִמְלוֹךְ:
דַּכְּאֵי רוּחַ נְמִיכוּת. מְחַפְּשֵׂי בְּיוֹם דִּין זְכוּת. דָּשָׁה בְּעֹל מַלְכוּת. עַד צוּר יִמְלֹךְ:
הִלּוּךְ מַהֲלָךְ. חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת הִלַּךְ. הָדוּר עַד הָמְלַךְ. בְּעֻזּוֹ לִמְלוֹךְ:
הַבֵּל הַמָּמְלָךְ. עַל מֶה מָלָךְ. הֲלֹא בְּמִי נִמְלָךְ. כִּי אָץ לִמְלוֹךְ:
וּמִלִּפְנֵי מְלֹךְ מֶלֶךְ. חַי מִלְּפָנִים מֶלֶךְ. וְעַד תִּכֶל כָּל מֶלֶךְ. הוּא לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ:
וּמַה יָעֹז מֹלֶךְ. בְּעֹז מִשְׁפַּט מֶלֶךְ. וְכַעֲבוֹר סוּפָה כְּהֵלֶךְ. יַחֲלוֹף מִמְּלוֹךְ:
זָךְ דִּין בְּעָרְכוֹ. יֹאחֵז דַּרְכּוֹ. זֵדִים בְּדָרְכוֹ. נָקָם יַעַט וְיִמְלֹךְ:
זֵר בְּשַׁלְּכוֹ. יִתֵּן עֹז לְמַלְכּוֹ. זַכִּים בְּהַמְלִיכוֹ. עַל כֹּל יִמְלֹךְ:
חִדְּשׁוּ מְלוּכָה. כַּדָּת וְכַהֲלָכָה. חֹטֶר מַמְלָכָה. בְּמִישׁוֹר יִמְלֹךְ:
חֹבֶשׁ אֲרוּכָה. וְאֹרֶךְ יוֹם מְבוּכָה. חֲתֻלָּה לְמַכָּה. יַעַל בְּעֵת יִמְלֹךְ:
טֹרַח מַלְכִיּוֹת. עוֹבְדֵי מַשְׂכִּיּוֹת. טִמְּאוּ חֶמֶד שְׂכִיּוֹת. בְּגַאֲוָה לִמְלוֹךְ:
טֹהַר זָכִיּוֹת. וְשַׁאַג קוֹל בְּכִיּוֹת. טֶבַע צוּל דָּכְיוֹת. יִפֶן וּבָם יִמְלֹךְ:
יָהַב מַשְׁלִיכִים. עָלָיו בְּנֵי מְלָכִים. יוֹם זֶה לוֹ מְחַכִּים. בּוֹ יָבֹא לִמְלוֹךְ:
יַעַבְרוּ מִתְהַלְּכִים. לְפָנָיו כְּמַלְאָכִים. יַחַד מַמְלִיכִים. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ:
כִּתִּים בְּכַתְּתוֹ. אִיִּים בְּהַכֹּתוֹ. כֵּס מַמְלַכְתּוֹ.
יִכּוֹן וְיִמְלֹךְ:
כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ. וְקָדוֹשׁ הֲלִיכָתוֹ. בְּגָמְרוֹ מְלַאכְתּוֹ. לְעֵין כֹּל יִמְלֹךְ:
לְכָל גֹּבַהּ יַפִּיל. וְהַר וָגֶבַע יַשְׁפִּיל. לְכָל אוֹם יַאְפִּיל. וּכְאוֹר זָרוּעַ יִמְלֹךְ:
לְרָאִי יַקְפִּיל. וַחֲדָשִׁים יַכְפִּיל. לְיוֹם זֶה פּוּר הִפִּיל. מִצִּיּוֹן לִמְלוֹךְ:
מָטוּ גוֹיִם. הָמוּ גֵּאִים. מָעֲדוּ מִתְגָּאִים. גֵּאֶה בְּבֹאוֹ לִמְלוֹךְ:
מָלְכוּ דְגוּיִם. נִטְּלוּ סְגוּיִם. מֶלֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם. עֵת אָתָא לִמְלוֹךְ:
נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים. יֵאָסְפוּ מֵעַמִּים. נְשׂוֹא מְעֻטֵּי עַמִּים. אֶל מְקוֹמָם יִמְלֹךְ:
נִגּוּן נְעִימִים. לְמוּלָם מַנְעִימִים. נְשָׂאָם מֵעֲמָמִים. עֲלֵיהֶם לִמְלוֹךְ:
סִכּוּת אֱלִילִים. כִּיּוּן
גִּלּוּלִים. סָחוֹב כְּמוֹ חֲלָלִים. יָשְׁלְכוּ בְּלִי לִמְלוֹךְ:
סוֹד אֵל אֵלִים. הָבוּ בְּנֵי אֵלִים. שְׂאוּ זִמְרָה וְהִלּוּלִים. לָאָדוֹן כִּי יִמְלֹךְ:
עִזּוּז יָד בְּהַשִּׂיאוֹ. לְהָרִים נְשִׂיאוֹ. עֲמֻסָיו בְּנַשְּׂאוֹ. יָעֹז וְיִמְלֹךְ:
עַל רוּם מַשָּׂאוֹ. יָדֵיהוּ בְּנָשְׂאוֹ. עַל הוֹד כִּסְאוֹ. יֵשֵׁב וְיִמְלֹךְ:
פּוּר תְּפוֹרֵר אֶרֶץ. בְּכִלָּיוֹן וְחֶרֶץ. פַּח בְּיוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ. יַרְגִּיז וְיִמְלֹךְ:
פַּחַד שׁוֹפְרוֹת עֶרֶץ. יְשַׁלֵּשׁ וּבָם יִרֶץ. פְּאֵר מִכְּנַף הָאָרֶץ. יַעֲלוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ:
צְבִי מֵהֲדֹם יַעַל. וְאֶדֶר מִשַּׁעַל. צַהַל מִשְּׁמֵי מַעַל. יְרַנְּנוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ:
צְבָאוֹת כָּל פֹּעַל. לְצַלְעָם יַרְמֵי תַּעַל. צְפִירַת פְּאֵר לְהַעַל. הֵן לְצֶדֶק יִמְלֹךְ:
קְצִינִים אֲשֶׁר מָלְכוּ. אַדֶּרֶת יַשְׁלִיכוּ.
קוֹל יִתְּנוּ וְיַמְלִיכוּ. לָאָדוֹן כִּי יִמְלֹךְ:
קְרוּאִים יִמְלוֹכוּ. וְאַחֲרָיו יַהֲלוֹכוּ. קוֹמְמִיּוּת יֵלֵכוּ. וּבְרֹאשָׁם יִמְלֹךְ:
רָז הַמְּכֻמָּן. לְיוֹם זֶה מְזֻמָּן. רָשׁוּם לְמוֹעֵד וּזְמַן. וּבוֹ נוֹקֵם יִמְלֹךְ:
רוֹעֶה נֶאֱמָן. בְּבֹאוֹ מִתֵּימָן. רוּחַ יַסְעִיר כְּתֵימָן. בְּגִלְעָד יִמְלֹךְ:
שִׁנְאַן עֲלִיּוֹת. וְסוֹד פְּלִיאִיּוֹת. שִׁיר מִתְלוּלִיּוֹת. יִפְצְחוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ:
שְׁאִיּוֹת תַּחְתִּיּוֹת. וְהוֹד אוֹתִיּוֹת. שְׁאוֹן הֲמוֹן בְּרִיּוֹת. יָרִיעוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ:
תְּכַן כֵּס כַּשֶּׁמֶשׁ. שְׁמוֹ לִפְנֵי שֶׁמֶשׁ. תָּאֳרוֹ כְּצֵאת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ. בְּמָלְכוֹ יִמְלֹךְ:
תּוֹמֵךְ מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ. וְעַד מְבוֹאַת שֶׁמֶשׁ. תַּמָּה בָּרָה כַּשֶּׁמֶשׁ. יְרוֹמֵם וְיִמְלֹךְ:
I pay homage to my King, when I walk before Him, I praise His royal might, how He girds Himself with strength and reigns.
When I cast away vanity, before the arrival of my king (the anointed) He will send the herald of my salvation (Elijah), and then will He reign.
On his approach, falsehood will cease to reign, the house of the proud will not reign, it will be destroyed so that it can no more reign.
He will walk in my midst, when he appears in order to reign, through his kingdom will I reign and then will He reign.
The owners of kingdoms, when He shatters kingdoms, both nations and kingdoms will He confound and then reign.
The scroll of the world’s paths, the book of the ways of life,
open this day for the merit of those who wait for Him to reign.
She with the princely tread, when the sound of (Esau’s) tears implored, said: ‘the kingdom is mine, who else can then reign?’
The lowly and humble who seek for merit on the day of judgment, are bowed by the yoke of the kingdom until the Rock shall reign.
There is wandering here and there on a way of five hundred years until in glory is He crowned and in His might shall He reign.
As to Bel set on a throne, over what does he reign? Through whom was he crowned that he has hastened to reign?
Before any king ruled, the Everlasting was king; and when all kings cease, He alone will reign.
What might has Molech before the might of the King’s judgment? When a whirlwind sweeps by him, he ceases to reign.
The Pure One arranges justice and holds fast to His way, when He treads down the proud, He wears vengeance
and reigns.
When He casts down the garland of the proud, He will give power to His appointed king, when He crowns the pure over all will He reign.
He renews the realm according to faith and law that the royal offspring may in equity reign.
He soothes in healing after the long time of trouble, He will bandage the wound at the time when He will reign.
The oppression of the kingdoms, worshippers of images, they have defiled the most precious sights in their pride to reign.
To the purity of merits, the roar of the sound of weeping of those cast into the raging floods the Lord will turn, and over them will He reign.
Upon Him the royal princes (Israel) lay their burden, on this day do they wait for Him that on it He will come to reign.
They pass while walking before Him like angels, paying homage in unison: ‘The Lord will reign’.
When He crushes the Kittim, when He smites the islands, the throne of His kingdom will be established and
He will reign.
The glory of His kingdom, the holiness of His course, will be apparent to all when He completes His work and will reign.
He will fold up the skies and unfold new skies on the day appointed by lot for Him from Zion to reign.
The nations falter, the proud clamour, the arrogant fall when the exalted One comes to reign.
Then those compared to the fish of the sea (Israel) shall rule, their multitude will be raised up when the King of nations comes forth to reign.
The noblest of the peoples shall be gathered from among the peoples to bring the smallest of peoples to their place where He will reign.
They will chant pleasant songs before them whom He has lifted up from among the peoples so that over them He may reign.
The idols of Sikkut, the abominations
of Kiyun, are dragged along as if slain, they are cast down so that they may not reign.
O assembly of the Supreme God, do homage, you sons of the powerful (forefathers), offer singing and praise to the Lord for He will reign.
When He lifts His strong hand to raise up His prince and exalts those He has carried, He will be powerful and reign.
When He raises His hand above the high heavens, on the splendour of His throne He will be seated and reign.
The earth is shaken by destruction and ruin, in which dwellers on earth will be ensnared when He will rage and reign.
Three times will He make sound the dread of powerful Shofar blasts and them will He favour, they will cause glory to rise from the end of the earth, for He will reign.
Beauty from the earth will ascend and glory from the sea, exultation from the heavens above, they will all rejoice when He will reign.
To the hosts of all creatures He brings remedy for their defects, aloud will they praise His glory: Behold in justice does He reign.
The princes
who once ruled, will throw off their raiment, they will offer praise and pay homage to the Lord when He will reign.
Those called by the Lord shall reign and after Him will they follow, upright will they walk and at their head will He reign.
The hidden secret (of the redemption) is prepared for this day, recorded for the time and season on which in retribution He will reign.
The Faithful Shepherd, when He comes from Teman, the wind will roar in Teman, in Gilead will He reign.
The heavenly Shinanim and the assembly of angels will utter a song of praise in the heights, for He will reign.
The depths of the earth, the marvellous heavenly bodies, the roaring mass of creatures, rejoice when He will reign.
Established shall be the throne of him who is like the sun (the anointed), his name existed even before the sun, his appearance is as the going out of the sun, in God’s realm will He reign.
He who from sunrise to sunset sustains the flawless people that is bright as the sun (Israel), will exalt and reign.

en.text: The source does not translate the Hebrew stanza beginning לכל גבה יפיל (scan266). The English continues at לראי יקפיל; no substitute translation is supplied.

rows.en: She with the princely tread, when the sound of (Esau’s) tears implored, said: ‘the kingdom is mine, who else can then reign?’

rows.he: דַּכְּאֵי רוּחַ נְמִיכוּת. מְחַפְּשֵׂי בְּיוֹם דִּין זְכוּת. דָּשָׁה בְּעֹל מַלְכוּת. עַד צוּר יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: The lowly and humble who seek for merit on the day of judgment, are bowed by the yoke of the kingdom until the Rock shall reign.

rows.he: הִלּוּךְ מַהֲלָךְ. חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת הִלַּךְ. הָדוּר עַד הָמְלַךְ. בְּעֻזּוֹ לִמְלוֹךְ:
rows.en: There is wandering here and there on a way of five hundred years until in glory is He crowned and in His might shall He reign.

rows.he: הַבֵּל הַמָּמְלָךְ. עַל מֶה מָלָךְ. הֲלֹא בְּמִי נִמְלָךְ. כִּי אָץ לִמְלוֹךְ:
rows.en: As to Bel set on a throne, over what does he reign? Through whom was he crowned that he has hastened to reign?

rows.he: וּמִלִּפְנֵי מְלֹךְ מֶלֶךְ. חַי מִלְּפָנִים מֶלֶךְ. וְעַד תִּכֶל כָּל מֶלֶךְ. הוּא לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: Before any king ruled, the Everlasting was king; and when all kings cease, He alone will reign.

rows.he: וּמַה יָעֹז מֹלֶךְ. בְּעֹז מִשְׁפַּט מֶלֶךְ. וְכַעֲבוֹר סוּפָה כְּהֵלֶךְ. יַחֲלוֹף מִמְּלוֹךְ:
rows.en: What might has Molech before the might of the King’s judgment? When a whirlwind sweeps by him, he ceases to reign.

rows.he: זָךְ דִּין בְּעָרְכוֹ. יֹאחֵז דַּרְכּוֹ. זֵדִים בְּדָרְכוֹ. נָקָם יַעַט וְיִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: The Pure One arranges justice and holds fast to His way, when He treads down the proud, He wears vengeance and reigns.

rows.he: זֵר בְּשַׁלְּכוֹ. יִתֵּן עֹז לְמַלְכּוֹ. זַכִּים בְּהַמְלִיכוֹ. עַל כֹּל יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: When He casts down the garland of the proud, He will give power to His appointed king, when He crowns the pure over all will He reign.

rows.he: חִדְּשׁוּ מְלוּכָה. כַּדָּת וְכַהֲלָכָה. חֹטֶר מַמְלָכָה. בְּמִישׁוֹר יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: He renews the realm according to faith and law that the royal offspring may in equity reign.

rows.he: חֹבֶשׁ אֲרוּכָה. וְאֹרֶךְ יוֹם מְבוּכָה. חֲתֻלָּה לְמַכָּה. יַעַל בְּעֵת יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: He soothes in healing after the long time of trouble, He will bandage the wound at the time when He will reign.

rows.he: טֹרַח מַלְכִיּוֹת. עוֹבְדֵי מַשְׂכִּיּוֹת. טִמְּאוּ חֶמֶד שְׂכִיּוֹת. בְּגַאֲוָה לִמְלוֹךְ:
rows.en: The oppression of the kingdoms, worshippers of images, they have defiled the most precious sights in their pride to reign.

rows.he: טֹהַר זָכִיּוֹת. וְשַׁאַג קוֹל בְּכִיּוֹת. טֶבַע צוּל דָּכְיוֹת. יִפֶן וּבָם יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: To the purity of merits, the roar of the sound of weeping of those cast into the raging floods the Lord will turn, and over them will He reign.

rows.he: יָהַב מַשְׁלִיכִים. עָלָיו בְּנֵי מְלָכִים. יוֹם זֶה לוֹ מְחַכִּים. בּוֹ יָבֹא לִמְלוֹךְ:
rows.en: Upon Him the royal princes (Israel) lay their burden, on this day do they wait for Him that on it He will come to reign.

rows.he: יַעַבְרוּ מִתְהַלְּכִים. לְפָנָיו כְּמַלְאָכִים. יַחַד מַמְלִיכִים. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: They pass while walking before Him like angels, paying homage in unison: ‘The Lord will reign’.

rows.he: כִּתִּים בְּכַתְּתוֹ. אִיִּים בְּהַכֹּתוֹ. כֵּס מַמְלַכְתּוֹ. יִכּוֹן וְיִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: When He crushes the Kittim, when He smites the islands, the throne of His kingdom will be established and He will reign.

rows.he: כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ. וְקָדוֹשׁ הֲלִיכָתוֹ. בְּגָמְרוֹ מְלַאכְתּוֹ. לְעֵין כֹּל יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: The glory of His kingdom, the holiness of His course, will be apparent to all when He completes His work and will reign.

rows.he: לְכָל גֹּבַהּ יַפִּיל. וְהַר וָגֶבַע יַשְׁפִּיל. לְכָל אוֹם יַאְפִּיל. וּכְאוֹר זָרוּעַ יִמְלֹךְ:
לְרָאִי יַקְפִּיל. וַחֲדָשִׁים יַכְפִּיל. לְיוֹם זֶה פּוּר הִפִּיל. מִצִּיּוֹן לִמְלוֹךְ:
rows.en: He will fold up the skies and unfold new skies on the day appointed by lot for Him from Zion to reign.

rows.he: מָטוּ גוֹיִם. הָמוּ גֵּאִים. מָעֲדוּ מִתְגָּאִים. גֵּאֶה בְּבֹאוֹ לִמְלוֹךְ:
rows.en: The nations falter, the proud clamour, the arrogant fall when the exalted One comes to reign.

rows.he: מָלְכוּ דְגוּיִם. נִטְּלוּ סְגוּיִם. מֶלֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם. עֵת אָתָא לִמְלוֹךְ:
rows.en: Then those compared to the fish of the sea (Israel) shall rule, their multitude will be raised up when the King of nations comes forth to reign.

rows.he: נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים. יֵאָסְפוּ מֵעַמִּים. נְשׂוֹא מְעֻטֵּי עַמִּים. אֶל מְקוֹמָם יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: The noblest of the peoples shall be gathered from among the peoples to bring the smallest of peoples to their place where He will reign.

rows.he: נִגּוּן נְעִימִים. לְמוּלָם מַנְעִימִים. נְשָׂאָם מֵעֲמָמִים. עֲלֵיהֶם לִמְלוֹךְ:
rows.en: They will chant pleasant songs before them whom He has lifted up from among the peoples so that over them He may reign.

rows.he: סִכּוּת אֱלִילִים. כִּיּוּן גִּלּוּלִים. סָחוֹב כְּמוֹ חֲלָלִים. יָשְׁלְכוּ בְּלִי לִמְלוֹךְ:
rows.en: The idols of Sikkut, the abominations of Kiyun, are dragged along as if slain, they are cast down so that they may not reign.

rows.he: סוֹד אֵל אֵלִים. הָבוּ בְּנֵי אֵלִים. שְׂאוּ זִמְרָה וְהִלּוּלִים. לָאָדוֹן כִּי יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: O assembly of the Supreme God, do homage, you sons of the powerful (forefathers), offer singing and praise to the Lord for He will reign.

rows.he: עִזּוּז יָד בְּהַשִּׂיאוֹ. לְהָרִים נְשִׂיאוֹ. עֲמֻסָיו בְּנַשְּׂאוֹ. יָעֹז וְיִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: When He lifts His strong hand to raise up His prince and exalts those He has carried, He will be powerful and reign.

rows.he: עַל רוּם מַשָּׂאוֹ. יָדֵיהוּ בְּנָשְׂאוֹ. עַל הוֹד כִּסְאוֹ. יֵשֵׁב וְיִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: When He raises His hand above the high heavens, on the splendour of His throne He will be seated and reign.

rows.he: פּוּר תְּפוֹרֵר אֶרֶץ. בְּכִלָּיוֹן וְחֶרֶץ. פַּח בְּיוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ. יַרְגִּיז וְיִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: The earth is shaken by destruction and ruin, in which dwellers on earth will be ensnared when He will rage and reign.

rows.he: פַּחַד שׁוֹפְרוֹת עֶרֶץ. יְשַׁלֵּשׁ וּבָם יִרֶץ. פְּאֵר מִכְּנַף הָאָרֶץ. יַעֲלוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: Three times will He make sound the dread of powerful Shofar blasts and them will He favour, they will cause glory to rise from the end of the earth, for He will reign.

rows.he: צְבִי מֵהֲדֹם יַעַל. וְאֶדֶר מִשַּׁעַל. צַהַל מִשְּׁמֵי מַעַל. יְרַנְּנוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: Beauty from the earth will ascend and glory from the sea, exultation from the heavens above, they will all rejoice when He will reign.

rows.he: צְבָאוֹת כָּל פֹּעַל. לְצַלְעָם יַרְמֵי תַּעַל. צְפִירַת פְּאֵר לְהַעַל. הֵן לְצֶדֶק יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: To the hosts of all creatures He brings remedy for their defects, aloud will they praise His glory: Behold in justice does He reign.

rows.he: קְצִינִים אֲשֶׁר מָלְכוּ. אַדֶּרֶת יַשְׁלִיכוּ. קוֹל יִתְּנוּ וְיַמְלִיכוּ. לָאָדוֹן כִּי יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: The princes who once ruled, will throw off their raiment, they will offer praise and pay homage to the Lord when He will reign.

rows.he: קְרוּאִים יִמְלוֹכוּ. וְאַחֲרָיו יַהֲלוֹכוּ. קוֹמְמִיּוּת יֵלֵכוּ. וּבְרֹאשָׁם יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: Those called by the Lord shall reign and after Him will they follow, upright will they walk and at their head will He reign.

rows.he: רָז הַמְּכֻמָּן. לְיוֹם זֶה מְזֻמָּן. רָשׁוּם לְמוֹעֵד וּזְמַן. וּבוֹ נוֹקֵם יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: The hidden secret (of the redemption) is prepared for this day, recorded for the time and season on which in retribution He will reign.

rows.he: רוֹעֶה נֶאֱמָן. בְּבֹאוֹ מִתֵּימָן. רוּחַ יַסְעִיר כְּתֵימָן. בְּגִלְעָד יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: The Faithful Shepherd, when He comes from Teman, the wind will roar in Teman, in Gilead will He reign.

rows.he: שִׁנְאַן עֲלִיּוֹת. וְסוֹד פְּלִיאִיּוֹת. שִׁיר מִתְלוּלִיּוֹת. יִפְצְחוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: The heavenly Shinanim and the assembly of angels will utter a song of praise in the heights, for He will reign.

rows.he: שְׁאִיּוֹת תַּחְתִּיּוֹת. וְהוֹד אוֹתִיּוֹת. שְׁאוֹן הֲמוֹן בְּרִיּוֹת. יָרִיעוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: The depths of the earth, the marvellous heavenly bodies, the roaring mass of creatures, rejoice when He will reign.

rows.he: תְּכַן כֵּס כַּשֶּׁמֶשׁ. שְׁמוֹ לִפְנֵי שֶׁמֶשׁ. תָּאֳרוֹ כְּצֵאת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ. בְּמָלְכוֹ יִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: Established shall be the throne of him who is like the sun (the anointed), his name existed even before the sun, his appearance is as the going out of the sun, in God’s realm will He reign.

rows.he: תּוֹמֵךְ מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ. וְעַד מְבוֹאַת שֶׁמֶשׁ. תַּמָּה בָּרָה כַּשֶּׁמֶשׁ. יְרוֹמֵם וְיִמְלֹךְ:
rows.en: He who from sunrise to sunset sustains the flawless people that is bright as the sun (Israel), will exalt and reign.
